$description: The monetary policy of avenCITY, as data. Every number the ledger uses comes from here; the code holds no constants of its own. Hearts are Circles: every human issues their OWN currency — maia♥, samuel♥ — at the same rate, continuously, and a gentle demurrage keeps value moving. The currencies become interchangeable later, as a layer on top; the notes never change.

currency.name: Hearts
currency.$description: One token per citizen, written as their name and the heart — maia♥ — minted only by them. 18 decimals like an ERC-20, so an upgrade to a real token contract changes no amount.

time.$description: One real day is one game month of thirty game days; twelve real days are a game year. Game time therefore runs thirty times faster than real time. The epoch is the city's founding — day 0, month 1 of year 1.

issuance.$description: One heart per GAME hour — 24 a game day, which is one every two real minutes, since a game day is 48 real minutes — accruing continuously and minted whenever the citizen likes. Unclaimed hearts stop accruing after 14 game days, as in Circles: money is for the present, not a savings plan you forgot about. A player's very first mint also carries the starting hearts — 30,000, enough to become the citizen of a city (25,000) and still back its coops.

demurrage.$description: 7% per game year (twelve real days), the Circles rate. Applied at display time only: notes are accounted in inflationary units and never change, and issuance rises to keep the demurraged 24 a day constant — so a heart earned today and a heart earned next year buy the same, and hoarding slowly loses.

ledger.$description: Shaped after Paladin's Zeto domain: a note is a Poseidon commitment over (amount, salt, owner key); spending publishes a nullifier; a zero-knowledge proof shows value is conserved. No notary sees the notes. Today the server runs the circuit's checks itself and records a mock proof; the base ledger is a table of commitments and nullifiers. The schema is the contract that lets it become a Paladin node without changing a note.

interchange.$description: Personal currencies are not fungible with each other. The one bridge today is investment: personal hearts put into a city or one of its coops become that city's HEARTS, one for one.

city.$description: Every city issues its own two currencies, named after it: <name>HEARTS, the city's common money, and <name>MINDS, the ownership of the city itself — Maia gives maiaHEARTS and maiaMINDS. Nobody mints a city's HEARTS directly: they come into being only when a player invests their personal hearts into the city or one of its coops, one for one, and they sit in that city's or coop's treasury.
